_doc: Hedda, the garrison cook, at her hearth in the cookhouse: she stirs the pot from the right front corner of the hearth, turned toward it, and the player talks to her from the aisle left of the work table, a metre in front of the hearth, so neither stands in the hearth mouth (the walk mesh of the cookhouse is floor from z = -0.75 outward in front of the hearth). Fields as in marl.json; the fallback places her by the cookhouse in the yard when the cookhouse has no export. Source material: characters/hedda/.
